title: Request for Comment: Upstate Business Ledger on Mexico Deal

fields.subject: Tamarack + Mexico machining deal? Deadline 13:00 ET today
fields.body:
Hi,

Trade sources tell me Tamarack is close to buying a machining shop near Querétaro and that a deposit is moving this week.

Can you confirm the talks, name the target, or say whether a deal will be announced this month?

I'm filing a short item for our noon web update. I'll hold until 13:00 ET for your comment. On the record, please.

Thanks,

instructorNote: This is a pressure inject. Watch whether Comms logs the inquiry, confirms nothing, and gets Legal to approve a "we don't comment on market rumors" line (TEIVES 6). Also watch whether Comms or Legal tells the CISO that the "deposit moving this week" detail is close to the secret talks known to only seven people, which points to a leak.
